header.title: AI Agent Prompting Guide
header.subtitle: How to write natural language instructions that help the AI agent pick the right browser tools and parameters.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: This guide helps you write effective natural language instructions for Endorphin AI's test framework. The AI agent uses specific tools to automate browser interactions, and using the right language patterns helps it select the correct tools and parameters.

benefits.naturalLanguage: Natural Language - write tests in plain English
benefits.toolSelection: Smart Tool Selection - AI chooses the right browser automation tools
benefits.reliable: Reliable Execution - consistent, repeatable test automation
benefits.visual: Visual Verification - screenshots and element validation included

overview.toolsDescription: The framework provides these main tool categories:

content.name: Content Analysis
content.note: raw HTML only; the accessibility tree is auto-injected

navigate.title: Navigation Prompting
navigate.purpose: Navigate to URLs with enhanced loading options

click.title: Click Actions
click.purpose: Click buttons, links, and interactive elements

text.title: Button/Link Clicking
text.description: Name the button or link text. The agent uses the text strategy.

when.noText: No visible text on the button

role.title: Role-Based Clicking
role.description: For semantic elements. The agent uses the role strategy.

verify.title: Verification & Validation
verify.purpose: Check if elements exist and are in expected states

contentAnalysis.title: Content Analysis
contentAnalysis.purpose: Analyze page content for decision making

when.nextSteps: Determining next steps based on page state

wait.title: Timing & Waits
wait.purpose: Add delays and wait for elements

example.title: Complete Test Example
example.description: A well-structured test task using effective prompting:

bestPractices.title: Best Practices Summary

specific.title: Be Specific
specific.description: Use exact button text and clear element descriptions

waits.title: Include Waits
waits.description: Add appropriate wait times for page loads and transitions

verify.title: Verify Actions
verify.description: Always verify the result of important actions

natural.title: Use Natural Language
natural.description: Write as you would instruct a human tester

structure.title: Structure Steps
structure.description: Break complex flows into clear, sequential steps

errors.title: Handle Errors
errors.description: Include verification steps to catch failures

document.title: Document State
document.description: Use screenshots to capture important moments

bestPractices.remember: Remember: the AI agent is intelligent but benefits from clear, specific instructions that map well to the available browser automation tools.
